# `RbacToolVisibility`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge\RbacToolVisibility`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpRbacBridge`](/packages/rbac-bridge) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp-rbac-bridge/blob/master/src/RbacToolVisibility.php)

The tools/list counterpart of RbacToolCallInterceptor: a tool whose
mapped permission the current identity does not hold disappears from the
listing (and yii3-mcp's visibility layer also fail-closed rejects calling
it by name). Same map, same decision — list and call can never disagree.
